Bank Full Model Test.question: ৫) ‘পথিক তুমি পথ হারাইয়াছ’-উক্তিটি কোন উপন্যাসের?

এ উপন্যাসের নায়িকা কপালকুণ্ডলা নায়ক নবকুমার কে উদ্দেশ্য করে বলে- 'পথিক তুমি পথ হারাইয়াছ!'।

• দুর্গেশনন্দিনী বাংলা সাহিত্যে উপন্যাসের গঠন, চরিত্রায়ন, এবং রোমান্টিক উপাদানের প্রাথমিক প্রবর্তনের কারণে প্রথম রোমান্টিক উপন্যাস হিসেবে গণ্য। তবে, এর রোমান্টিক উক্তি তুলনামূলকভাবে সংযত।

• দুর্গেশনন্দিনীতে জগৎ সিং ও তিলোত্তমার প্রেমকাহিনি থাকলেও, এটি ঐতিহাসিক ও রাজনৈতিক প্রেক্ষাপটে আবদ্ধ। প্রেমের উক্তিগুলো সংযত এবং সমাজের নৈতিকতার সীমার মধ্যে ছিল।
কপালকুণ্ডলা (১৮৬৬) বঙ্কিমচন্দ্রের দ্বিতীয় উপন্যাস, যা রোমান্টিকতার দিক থেকে আরও গভীর ও কাব্যিক। এই উপন্যাসে নবকুমার ও কপালকুণ্ডলার প্রেমকাহিনি প্রকৃতি, রহস্য, এবং রোমান্টিক আবেগের সঙ্গে জড়িত।কপালকুণ্ডলায় রোমান্টিক উক্তি বা প্রেমের ভাষা অধিক স্পষ্ট, কাব্যিক, এবং আবেগপ্রবণ।

• ‘পথিক, তুমি পথ হারাইয়াছ!’ উক্তিটি এই উপন্যাসের রোমান্টিক ভাবধারার প্রতীক হিসেবে বিবেচিত, কারণ এটি কেবল একটি বাক্য নয়, বরং প্রেম, রহস্য, এবং প্রকৃতির মিলনের প্রতিনিধিত্ব করে।

সূত্র: বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য জিজ্ঞাসা, ড. সৌমিত্র শেখর।

Bank Full Model Test.question: ১৯) The research study is an eye opener and <u>attempts to acquaint</u> us with the problems of poor nations.
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Correct Sentence: The research study is an eye opener and attempts at acquainting us with the problems of poor nations.

Attempts can be followed by at (and a gerund) if attempts is a noun. Note that it can also use to and the infinitive form of the verb.
I made several attempts at doing that.
If attempts is a verb, it must be followed by to and an infinitive.
It attempts to do that.
If the sentence is lengthened, then attempts can be made into a noun, but an additional comma helps:
The research study is an eye-opener, and attempts at acquainting us with the problems of poor nations are ultimately successful.

Bank Full Model Test.question: ২৯) Did you <u>get</u> what the teacher was saying?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
The meaning of the word 'get' changes with the context of the sentence.
Here, the teacher is saying something to the listener of this question, and the speaker is asking if they could comprehend what the teacher was saying.
'Get' is used informally here, and the best option that can explain it is the word 'understand' because it means 'to perceive the meaning of or comprehend', which means the same as 'get' in the sentence.

Hence option D is correct. From the other options, 'know' means 'to be aware or have knowledge of', it does not mean the same as 'get' because 'know' is used when the person is already aware of what is being said, whereas 'get' here does not suggest that.

Hence option A is incorrect. To receive is to acquire possession of something, like a gift, a title, or any information. The context of this sentence does not mean that the teacher is giving something that is to be acquired, but it is ought to be comprehended, hence option B is incorrect. To recognize means to identify something that you have previously seen or known. It is not synonymous with 'get' and hence option C is incorrect.

Bank Full Model Test.question:

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৩) A car traveling with 5/7 of its actual speed covers 42 km in 1 hr 40 min 48 sec. What is the actual speed of the car?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
time = 1 hr 40 min 48 sec
= 1 hr + 40/60 hr + 48/3600 hr
= 1 + 2/3 + 1/75 = 126/75 hr
distance = 42 km
speed = distance/time = 42/( 126/75 ) = (42 × 75)/126 = 25 km/hr
⇒ 5/7 of the actual speed = 25
⇒ Actual speed = 25 × 7/5 = 35 km/hr

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৪) A man travelled a distance of 61km in 9 hours. He travelled partly on foot at 4 km/hr and partly on bicycle at 9 km/hr. What is the distance travelled on foot?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Let the time in which he travelled on foot = x hr
Then the time in which he travelled on bicycle = (9 − x ) hr
distance = speed × time
⇒ 4 x + 9 (9 − x) = 61
⇒ 4 x + 81 − 9 x = 61
⇒ 5 x = 20
⇒ x = 4
Distance travelled on foot = 4x
= 4 × 4
= 16 km

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৫) A is thrice as good as B at work. A is able to finish a job in 60 days less than B. They can finish the work in _____ days if they work together.
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
If A completes a work in 1 day, B completes the same work in 3 days.
This means, difference is 2 days, if B completes the work in 3 days
Therefore, difference is 60 days, if B completes the work in 90 days

⇒ Amount of work B can do in 1 day = 1/90
Amount of work A can do in 1 day = 3 × 1/90 = 1/30

Amount of work A and B can together do in 1 day = 1/90 + 1 /30 = 4/90 = 2/45
Therefore, A and B together can do the work in 45/2 days = 22 (1/2) days

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৬) The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 7 : 8 . If the second train runs 400 km in 4 hours, What is the speed of the first train?

Speed of the first train = 7x = 7 × 12.5
= 87.5 km/hr

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৩৯) Present ages of Ovi and Robi are in the ratio 5 : 4 . Three years hence, the ratio of their ages will become 11 : 9 . What is Robi's present age in years?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Ratio of present ages of Ovi and Robi = 5 : 4
Let present age of Ovi = 5x
Present age of Robi = 4x
After 3 years, ratio of their ages = 11 : 9
⇒ (5x + 3 ) : (4x + 3) = 11 : 9
⇒ 9 (5x + 3) = 11 (4x + 3 )
⇒ 45x + 27 = 44 x + 33
⇒ x = 33 − 27 = 6
Robi's present age = 4 x
= 4 × 6
= 24

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪০) A work can be finished in 16 days by 20 women. The same work can be finished in 15 days by 16 men. The ratio between the efficiency of a man and a woman is -

= 1/(15 × 16) : 1/(16 × 20)
= 1/15 : 1/20
= 1/3 : 1/4
= 4 : 3

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪২) If the selling price is doubled, the profit triples. What is the profit percent?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:

Then, profit = y − x

profit = 2y − x

2y − x = 3 (y − x)
⇒ 2y − x = 3y − 3 x
⇒ y = 2x

profit percent = (x × 100)x

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪৩) If the lengths of the three sides of a triangle are 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm, then what is the length of the median to its greatest side?
Bank Full Model Test.exp:
Lengths, 6, 8 and 10 are Pythagorean triples. So legs are 6 and 8 and hypotenuse or greatest side is 10. Median BD bisects AC, so AD = CD = 5 cm.

Alternative:
Cosine of angle C is 6/10 or 3/5.
By Cosine rule,
BD = √[36 + 25 - (2 × 5 × 6 × 3)/5]
=> BD = √(25) = 5 cm.

Bank Full Model Test.question: ৪৪) There are two examination rooms A and B. If 10 students are sent from A to B, then the number of students in each room is the same. If 20 candidates are sent from B to A, then the number of students in A is double the number of students in B. The number of students in room A is:
Bank Full Model Test.exp:

Then, x - 10 = y + 10
Or, x - y = 20 .... (i)

And x + 20 = 2(y - 20)
Or, x - 2y = -60 .... (ii)

Solving (i) and (ii) we get: x = 100, y = 80.
The required answer A = 100.
